notes.title: I`m Isekai Hero - TRY IT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41678531/8f9915a9d65d2cf0fd09b6fcb1bc310be9fc9222.gif[/img]

[b]I`m Isekai Hero[/b]

Welcome to the extraordinary and magical island of your dreams!
If you have always wanted to reach the island where the secret desires of every man come true, then this is the very island where it is possible!
On the island, you will meet 8 lovely and different girls. Each of them has its own individual character and unique skills. 
You will have an exciting journey, interesting dialogues, and true love. But there is one condition - your character must die. 
The island has one unspoken rule: play with one hand!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587950/Im_Isekai_Hero/

Please help us make game better, dont forget write a review!

notes.title: The winter sale and future game "I`m Iseka Hero"
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41678531/595335b21dbc1fd75efeb640e4dc766d7fb00273.gif[/img]
[h2]About game[/h2]
Welcome to the extraordinary and magical island of your dreams! If you have always wanted to reach the island where the secret desires of every man come true, then this is the very island where it is possible! On the island, you will meet 8 lovely and different girls. Each of them has its own individual character and unique skills.
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
I`m Isekai Hero is a match3 game with magical obstacles that make the game a bit more challenging. To complete the game, you need to disassemble the previously prepared game level piece by piece. On the island you will meet 8 cute girls, each of whom complicates the game with their magical abilities.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587950/Im_Isekai_Hero
